content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing issues when trying to communicate with [product_name]. Sometimes my program downloads without any problems, but other times I encounter transmission errors such as "receive buffer empty" or "Port is not available." I'm unsure what's causing this and would appreciate your assistance.

Hi, could you provide some additional details: 1) Installed operating system, 2) Version of [product_name] software, 3) Complete part number of your device, and 4) Part number of the connection cable? Thank you.

Here is the information you requested: 1) Operating system: Windows 7, 2) Software version: [product_name] V[version_no], 3) Device part number: [article_no], 4) Connection cable part number: [article_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users report sporadic transmission errors while communicating with [product_name] hardware using [product_name] software on Windows 7. Communication reliability is inconsistent: while sometimes successful, it frequently produces errors like 'receive buffer empty' and 'Port is not available.' This unpredictability interrupts workflow and generates uncertainty among users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect stable and dependable communication between [product_name] software and the associated hardware, free from random transmission failures.
